command:
set -e
if [ -z "$$DATABASE_URL" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: DATABASE_URL is not set" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -x /usr/local/bin/assert-migration-image-freshness ]; then
  echo "ERROR: stale db-migrate image lacks the freshness assertion; expected migration $${WRFCOIN_EXPECTED_DB_MIGRATION}.sql" >&2
  exit 1
fi
/usr/local/bin/assert-migration-image-freshness
echo "Running Drizzle migrations..."
node node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs migrate
echo "Migrations complete."
reason: runs drizzle-kit (node_modules/drizzle-kit/bin.cjs), not a backend bundle; the multi-line preflight (DATABASE_URL check, image-freshness assertion) is reviewed by hand
